messages.author: 28accc6a1d47de34
messages.subject: Low %reads assigned to hg19
parts:
This is my first time using featureCounts so I apologize for my ignorance, but so far I've found it to be the best for handling PE reads.

I'm trying to assign PE reads from human samples using the hg19 gtf annotation file. My command is:
featureCounts -T 2 -p -t exon -g gene_id -a ${GTF} -o counts.txt ${FILE1}"

Prior to running featureCounts, I aligned with STAR and sorted with samtools by name.
I am getting around 30-60% succesfully assigned. These succesfully aligned fragments range from about 40-50% of the uniquely mapped reads from STAR.
Are these values to be expected, or are they on the low side? As I'm new to rna-seq pipelines, any explanation of these values would be much appreciated.

Thanks,
Greg
